item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies will be clear to mostly clear with low temperatures ranging from the mid-thirties to the upper thirties and no precipitation expected. Tomorrow brings partly cloudy to mostly clear conditions through the day, with high temperatures from the mid-fifties to near sixty and dry weather across the region. Tomorrow night remains partly cloudy with lows in the upper thirties to mid-forties and no precipitation.
